## The question

Where do current AI systems fail in consequential, measurable ways, and what practical changes improve their reliability?

Agent reliability is the provisional starting point. The specific research question will follow a review of existing work and a small reproduction.

## Current status

**Problem selection and initial reading.** No experiments or results have been published yet.

## What this project will contain

- [Reading notes](reading.qmd) connecting published claims to concrete examples and possible tests.
- [Experiments](experiments.qmd) with explicit baselines, methods, evidence, and limitations.
- [Progress](progress.qmd) recording meaningful decisions and next steps.

Published findings, working hypotheses, and results reproduced here will be identified separately.
